scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently "npm run dev:llm" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend-client && npm install && cd ../frontend-admin && npm install
scripts.install:llm: cd ml/server && python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.train:llm: cd ml/data && python prepare_data.py && cd ../train && python finetune.py
